title: fix(scripts): a diff of sdui.manifest.json alone now derives pnpm check:sdui-reference
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi8irujFEnBnqcKvK4Kv1YDL)_
Fixes #27367

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs` 新增一行 `ROOT_FILE_WATCH_HINTS = ['sdui.manifest.json/**']` 声明它读取仓根清单，并在其自测里校验该声明与 `MANIFEST_PATH` 一致；`dispatch-gates` 自测加两条用例钉住这一推导。
- 为什么改：只改 `sdui.manifest.json` 的 PR 之前推导不出 `pnpm check:sdui-reference`，开发者照工具清单跑完仍会在 CI 变红；现在能推导出来。
- 风险与回滚：只动仓根 `scripts/`，不发布任何包，不改匹配器；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`（声明与自测里的声明校验）、`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`（两条新用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands sdui.manifest.json`，预期输出里出现 `pnpm check:sdui-reference`（main 上没有）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`: declares the repo-root manifest it reads as `ROOT_FILE_WATCH_HINTS = ['sdui.manifest.json/**']`, the same hint `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` declares for that file. The bare `MANIFEST_PATH` literal has no separator, and `hintCovers` refuses that shape as too generic, so only `OUT_DIR` was visible to the derivation. Per the triage ruling, the matcher is not widened. The fix is this declaration.
- The same file's `--self-test` now checks the declaration, the way `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` checks its own (outside the cases table, so the battery roster and floor do not change). It fails when the declared paths are not exactly `[MANIFEST_PATH]`, and when a repo-root entry is missing the `/**` suffix.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: two cases beside the existing repo-root-file declarations. They run against the live fleet (`discoverFamilies()` + `placeFamily`). (1) A diff of `sdui.manifest.json` alone places `check:sdui-reference` as `matched`. (2) `examples/sdui.manifest.json` does not, so the declaration covers only the one file it names.
- ⛔ No change to `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` or `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`. No changeset: root `scripts/` belongs to no published package (the root manifest `@objectstack/spec-monorepo` is `private: true`), so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- Hint name: `ROOT_FILE_WATCH_HINTS`, not `ROOT_WATCH_HINTS`. `check-watch-hint-literal.mjs` defines the name as the kind of root: repo-root files are `ROOT_FILE_`, mixed roots are `ROOT_`. This population is one repo-root file. The hint value is byte-identical to the one `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` declares, and `check:watch-hint-literal` admits it (14 `ROOT_FILE_WATCH_HINTS` declarations, previously 13).

## Tests

Tree: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3e920461` (base `ded67bfb`).

- `pnpm check:sdui-reference`: exit 0. `✓ gen-sdui-reference self-test: 20 cases pass.` and `✓ gen-sdui-reference --check: content/docs/ui/components/ matches sdui.manifest.json (106 components on 7 pages).`
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: exit 0. `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1937 cases pass; 7 slow section(s) deferred.` The two new cases ran in the fast tier:
  - `✓ a diff of sdui.manifest.json alone derives pnpm check:sdui-reference`
  - `✓ and that declaration claims no same-named file inside a directory`
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (21 cases).
- The new placement case fails on the base tree, measured with the same calls in a probe script. On `ded67bfb` the family's hints were `["content/docs/ui/components"]` and `placeFamily(..., ['sdui.manifest.json']).verdict` was `silent`. On `3e920461` the hints are `["content/docs/ui/components","sdui.manifest.json/**"]` and the verdict is `matched`. `ui/apps/console/sdui.manifest.json` stays `silent`.

## Acceptance notes

- No other gate was surveyed for the same miss (a root-level file read with no hint). Per the triage, finding many such gates would be a card for a lint over gate scripts, not a matcher change. Nothing here measured how many there are.

## Verification

<details><summary>Before / after: dispatch-gates --commands sdui.manifest.json</summary>

Before, on `ded67bfb` (11 commands, no `check:sdui-reference`):

```text
node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs
node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test
node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs
node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs
node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs --self-test
node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test
pnpm check:driver-memory-census
pnpm check:gitlink-declared
pnpm check:nul-bytes
pnpm check:refd-timer-probe
pnpm check:watch-hint-literal
```

After, on `3e920461` (12 commands): the same 11 rows plus `pnpm check:sdui-reference`. `diff before after` prints exactly `> pnpm check:sdui-reference`. Footer moves from `11 command(s) — 5 pnpm, 6 direct node (3 matched by path …)` to `12 command(s) — 6 pnpm, 6 direct node (4 matched by path …)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates derived for this diff (31), with exit codes</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3e920461` derived 31 commands. Each one ran with exit 0:

`check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-declaration-mirrors` (+ `--self-test`), `check-self-test-wired` (+ `--self-test`), `check-self-test-workflow-commands` (+ `--self-test`), `check-whole-set-label-write` (+ `--self-test`), `ci/plan-test-core-shards --self-test`, `pm/bare-root-worklist --self-test`, and `pnpm check:` `agent-test-spelling`, `bash32-floor`, `ci-filter-parity`, `cli-command-ids`, `cross-package-test-inputs`, `driver-memory-census`, `entry-guard`, `gitlink-declared`, `nul-bytes`, `parse-guard`, `pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm-filter-targets`, `pnpm-flag-spellings`, `ratchet-remedy-authority`, `refd-timer-probe`, `scripts-symbol-anchors`, `sdui-reference`, `watch-hint-literal`.

Reconciliation, `--ran` over a record carrying an exit code on every row: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 31 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 31 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`

CI-only steps that `--commands` does not print (Plan Test Core shards and the type-check lanes) are left to this PR's check-runs.

</details>
